alt: Nearly full Moon photographed from Hamois, Belgium, with dark maria and bright cratered highlands.
caption: Nearly full Moon photographed from Hamois, Belgium. The phase is nearly the same for observers in Wales and California at the same instant; local rise times and the disc's orientation differ.

alt: Sunlit shingle beach and coastal buildings at Southsea, Portsmouth.
caption: Southsea, Portsmouth. Land and sea warm at different rates in sunshine, creating conditions that can support a sea breeze. A photograph of the coast alone does not measure its wind direction.
